preconditions.description: The number of users n must be between 2 and 250,000.
Both T_1 and T_2 must have exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges_T1) and all(1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n for c, d in edges_T2)
preconditions.description: All edges in T_1 and T_2 must connect valid user indices.

postconditions.description: The number of protected edges m must be non-negative and less than n.
The number of output edges must match the number of protected edges m.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) in edges_T1 and (c, d) in edges_T2 for a, b, c, d in output_edges)
postconditions.description: All output edges must be valid edges from T_1 and T_2.
